description: The tasks people asked THIS token's agent from ViralHunt's composer: read them (claimed as you read; peek=true reads without claiming) or answer one. Each task carries the post as it is on the screen (body, first_comment, author_notes, kind, media, thread, accounts with text_limit and the per-account overrides), the project's voice and lang, the limits per network, a reply_schema and expires_at (15 minutes). Answer with reply_id plus what you change: text (what you tell the person), fields {body, first_comment ('' = none), author_notes, kind, overrides {account_id: {body, first_comment?, thread?}}, thread [string], media_add / media_replace [https url]}, image {url} or {base64, mime}, warnings [{code, text, network?}]; or progress ('working' + text), or error. The browser applies fields with Undo and the person saves; never edit the post through viralhunt_update_post for a task. Poll every minute while you serve that organization.

error.description: You cannot do it: the task is closed as failed with this reason.

fields.description: What changes on the screen: body, first_comment, author_notes, kind, overrides, thread, media_add, media_replace.

image.description: One picture you made: {url} or {base64, mime, mode?: 'replace'|'add'}.

peek.description: true = read without claiming the queued tasks.

progress.description: A progress line: the task stays open (status working).

reply_id.description: Answer this task instead of reading the list.

name: viralhunt_agent_tasks
